## OwnCode v0.4.1

This patch release improves tool progress and adds model catalog refresh. It does not introduce a major version change.

### Model catalog refresh

- Press `F7` or `Ctrl+R` in the model picker to refresh the highlighted provider's connected ChatGPT or Claude account.
- Catalog requests run in the background with a timeout. ChatGPT credentials refresh when needed.
- Refresh preserves the active model, search, and favorites. Failed requests keep the existing catalog.
- Refresh requires idle agents. Models removed from a connected catalog no longer appear as selectable custom models.

### Tool and worker progress

- Tool panels distinguish queued calls from running operations. File reads show `Reading file` instead of a generic response wait.
- Completed tool results appear before the next tool starts. Parallel agent batches retain their existing execution order.
- Updated results invalidate the parent panel cache, so completed operations no longer keep stale waiting text.
- Worker cards distinguish model waiting, finishing, and completion instead of showing `Waiting to start` for active work.

### Validation

- Go tests, `go vet`, build, and installer tests passed.
- Focused race tests cover the affected agent, message, auth, and TUI packages.
- Validation used local fixtures without live model calls.

### Upgrade

```sh
brew update
brew upgrade owncode
```

For a new installation, run `brew install muratmirgun/tap/owncode`.
Release archives support macOS and Linux on arm64 and x86_64.
